description.zh: 应用分组ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
description.en: The application group ID. You can obtain the application group ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
description.en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
description.en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

description.zh:
时间表达式，根据选择的时间类型设置时间表达式。

- cron：填写标准的cron表达式，支持在线验证。
- api：无时间表达式。
description.en:
The time expression. You can set the time expression based on the selected method that is used to specify time.

*   If you set TimeType to cron, you need to enter a standard cron expression. Online verification is supported.
*   If you set TimeType to api, no time expression is required.

description.zh:
时间类型，目前支持以下几种时间类型：

- cron：1
- api：100
description.en:
The method that is used to specify the time. Valid values:

*   1: cron
*   100: api

title.zh: 更新工作流的基本信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 update-workflow --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --workflow-id 123 --name helloworld --description Test --time-type 1 --time-expression 0_0/10_0_0_0_0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 UpdateWorkflow --region cn-hangzhou --Description Test --NamespaceSource schedulerx --TimeExpression '0_0/10_0_0_0_0' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --WorkflowId 123 --Namespace 'adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000' --GroupId 'testSchedulerx.defaultGroup' --Name helloworld --TimeType 1
